metadata.title: Retro Soul Album Back Cover Layout

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition featuring a black header with stylized geometric typography, a central cinematic color photograph of a woman looking out a window, and a white footer containing structured technical tracklist information.
coreVisualRelationships: Black header and white footer sandwiching a central color image
Geometric, thin-stroke display type contrasting with dense, small-scale body text
Warm, natural light in the photograph against stark monochrome graphic blocks
Horizontal alignment of the subject's arm with the window pane grid

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower right quadrant of the central image, medium close-up, looking left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white geometric display text in the top black bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starts at the bold header, moves through the subject's gaze in the photo, and settles on the detailed tracklist below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the black header and white footer to balance the busy photographic center.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Naturalistic earth tones (browns, blues, greens in the photo)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and soft blue clothing
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the outer blocks; muted saturation within the central photograph.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking or tightly kerned circular glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stylized geometric display paired with functional, condensed gothic/sans-serif for data.
graphicDevices: Thin black borders for tracklist boxes
Dotted leader lines for track times

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and 1970s display feel.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and thin stroke weight.
Appropriate for the technical tracklist information in the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a three-tier layout. Top tier is a solid black rectangle. Middle tier is a 1970s-style color photograph of a woman with voluminous dark hair looking out a wooden-framed window with a green plant in the foreground. Bottom tier is a solid white rectangle with two thin-bordered boxes side-by-side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white geometric sans-serif text centered in the top black bar. Add black condensed sans-serif text inside the two boxes in the white footer, arranged in columns with dotted lines.

verificationChecks: Is the top text white on a black background?
Does the central image feature a window-pane grid?
Are there two distinct tracklist boxes in the footer?
Is the display font strictly geometric with circular 'O's?

adjustableVariables: Color of the central photograph tint
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the display text is perfectly centered in the black bar.
Check that the tracklist boxes are symmetrical.
Verify the photo has a soft, natural grain consistent with 70s film.
Confirm no text bleeds into the photographic section.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a black header with [Geometric Font], a central [Subject] in a [Setting] photo, and a white footer with [Grid-based Data] to create a vintage soul aesthetic.
